_comment: KNOCKOUT FIXTURE. A well-formed deck-level static declaration. Used twice: once over a deck that genuinely has no motion (must report not-applicable, exit 3) and once over a deck carrying a real timing tree (must FAIL — a claim contradicted by its own artefact is a defect, not a pass).
rationale: Fixture deck. Its recipe never asked for motion, so an absence of <p:timing> is the intended outcome rather than a loss.
